d.subject: Confirmed Alpha3 same-source precise temporal monotonicity gap
d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.finding: Increasing SAMSUNG_PRECISE sample sequence does not guarantee nondecreasing observedUptimeMs. Current offerPrecise accepts a still-fresh regressing timestamp and sets preciseValidUntil=observed+192, allowing the active precise lease deadline to move backward; continuity also receives the raw regressing source time.
d.sourceMechanism: DuoShellService.AngleReader derives sourceUptime from logcat -v epoch wall time and System.currentTimeMillis, converted onto SystemClock.uptimeMillis; sequence is independently assigned by Fold7AnglePipelineGen2.
d.recommendedInvariant: Same-source later precise sequence must not regress semantic time or the existing lease deadline; anomalies stay observable and must not extend authority indefinitely.

en: Current Alpha3 can accept a logically later Samsung precise sample whose derived source timestamp regresses. That accepted sample can shorten the precise-authority lease to near-immediate expiry. Three deterministic harnesses passed (37/37 checks total). This is source+test confirmed, not yet physical-Fold7 confirmed; no production writes were made.
